name: Ushiroku Mikari
source:
[u][b]Magical Girl ☆ Mikarin[/b][/u]
[b]SR Evaluation Value: 9/10[/b]
Occupation:First-year student
Height:Short
Bust:Large

She channels the thoughts and wishes of people into her magical staff, battling evil demons day and night—that is the duty of Magical Girl ☆ Mikarin.
However… the most important thing, "thoughts and wishes," aren’t reaching her.
Without those, her magical staff becomes clouded, losing its power and turning into nothing more than a regular stick…
Up until now, Mikarin (Mikari) has fought alone, but she has come to realize that for her to truly shine as a magical girl, she needs a dependable assistant. It was at that moment that she met the protagonist, who had just arrived at the academy.

[i]What kind of girl is she?[/i]
A cheerful and optimistic girl. To gather the warm feelings and wishes of people, she runs the "Magical Girl ☆ Mikarin" official channel. However, at the moment, she receives more cold comments than warm ones, leading to daily comment battles (flame wars).

「I've got a reliable assistant now! ☆」
